Itemized Home Renovation Estimate Georgia

You're looking for a detailed and transparent estimate for your home renovation project in Georgia, and you've come to the right place. On this site, you can get a free, written, and itemized quote for your project, and our team will respond within one business day.

How to Get Your Itemized Estimate

To get started, you can fill out the quote form on our site or contact us at info@buildheritage.org. We serve metro Atlanta and Georgia, including areas like Atlanta, Marietta, Alpharetta, and many more. Our team of experts will work with you to understand your project needs and provide a detailed estimate that includes all the necessary work and costs. We offer 8 trades, including painting, drywall, flooring, and roofing, to ensure that your project is completed to the highest standards.

What You Get and What It Costs

Our cost guide, updated in August 2026, provides ranges for common renovation projects, such as full roof replacement ($9,000-$20,000) and whole-home interior repaint ($3,000-$8,000). We also recommend holding back 10-15% on top of your quote for any hidden issues that may arise during the project. Our team is licensed and insured in Georgia, giving you peace of mind throughout the process.

FAQ

What areas do you serve? We serve metro Atlanta and Georgia, including cities like Atlanta, Marietta, Alpharetta, and many more. You can check our service areas page for a full list. How long does it take to get a quote? We respond to all quote requests within one business day. What if I have hidden issues in my project? We recommend holding back 10-15% on top of your quote to account for any unexpected issues that may arise during the project.

Get your itemized home renovation estimate now
